questions.stem: An architect counts chords above pedal neither tonic nor dominant; if 7 total, 2 tonic/dominant, how many neither?

questions.explanation: Seven minus two equals five. The key, "5 chords", is the only choice consistent with that relation. "9 chords" is tempting because it includes an extra unit beyond the stated total, but it does not follow from the figures given.

questions.topic: Why a diminished seventh chord can serve several keys
questions.stem: On a rehearsal chart, in brief, designer asks diminished seventh multiple keys; write short explanation.
